chunks: Or show you some of what We have promised them. They are certainly well within Our power.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says 'Or show you some of what We have promised them'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the dual nature of divine power, affirming that Allah can either grant the Prophet (peace be upon him) a vision of the promised retribution or execute it directly, thereby validating the certainty of the Hereafter. It serves as a source of comfort for the Prophet amidst the disbelievers' arrogance, highlighting that divine omnipotence is not merely theoretical but actively capable of manifesting justice. This reinforces the concept of *Adl* (Divine Justice), where the punishment is not arbitrary but a direct consequence of the disbelievers' own actions.
